item.title: 2ms (too many secrets)
item.description: Import 2ms reports in JSON format. 2ms scans repositories, filesystems and collaboration platforms such as Confluence, Discord, Slack and Paligo for exposed secrets.

item.title: 42Crunch
item.description:
Import a 42Crunch Security Audit or Conformance Scan report.

This exists for organisations that cannot grant 42Crunch API credentials — air-gapped networks, procurement restrictions, a pending security review. The DefectDojo Pro 42Crunch connector pulls the same data over the API; this parser accepts the same data as a file.

item.title: AIDE
item.description: AIDE (Advanced Intrusion Detection Environment) is a file integrity monitor. It records a baseline of the filesystem — permissions, ownership, size, timestamps, checksums — and a later --check reports every path that has since been added, removed or changed.

item.title: Alert Logic
item.description: The Alert Logic parser for DefectDojo supports imports from CSV format. This document details the parsing of Alert Logic vulnerability scan exports into DefectDojo field mappings, unmapped fields, and transformation notes for easier troubleshooting and analysis.
